title: The Obesity Code Lecture (Why do we get Fat?) Part 1
summary: Dr. Jason Fung lectures on why obesity became an epidemic since the 1970s, arguing insulin and hormones rather than calories drive weight gain. He explains why calorie counting fails and touches on low-carb eating and fasting.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a compelling alternative explanation of obesity from a prominent proponent.

quote.text: Dr. Jason Fung has a very interesting and, in my opinion, compelling explanation of obesity and weight gain.
